facts.text: The hotel stands in the heart of Umeda, Osaka.
facts.excerpt: stands gracefully in the heart of Umeda

facts.text: The interior is reminiscent of an 18th-century British aristocratic residence.
facts.excerpt: you are enveloped in an elegant world reminiscent of an 18th‑century British aristocratic residence

facts.text: It was Japan's first Ritz-Carlton.
facts.excerpt: Since becoming Japan’s first Ritz-Carlton

facts.text: The hotel opened in 1997.
facts.excerpt: The Ritz-Carlton Osaka opened in 1997

facts.text: Forbes Travel Guide gave the hotel its Five-Star rating in 2026, for the fourth consecutive year.
facts.excerpt: In 2026, the hotel was honored with the prestigious Five-Star rating from Forbes Travel Guide for the fourth consecutive year

facts.text: The guest rooms and suites occupy the 24th through the 37th floors.
facts.excerpt: Located on the 24th through the 37th floors

facts.text: A 2024 renovation of the guest rooms preserved the European classic style while adding contemporary touches and enhanced comfort.
facts.excerpt: The 2024 renovation preserved the refined elegance of the beloved European classic style while introducing contemporary sensibilities and enhanced comfort

facts.text: The Japanese Suite has a tateiwa stone entrance, cedar-paneled bathroom walls and a granite soaking tub.
facts.excerpt: The entrance is lined with tateiwa stone, whose beauty deepens with time; the bathroom features cedar-paneled walls and a granite soaking tub

facts.text: The Club Lounge is on the 34th floor.
facts.excerpt: Located on the 34th floor, The Ritz-Carlton Club Lounge is an exclusive space

facts.text: La Baie, the French restaurant, was awarded one Michelin star in the Michelin Guide Kyoto Osaka 2026.
facts.excerpt: We feature the French Restaurant La Baie, awarded one star in “Michelin Guide Kyoto・Osaka 2026”

facts.text: Hanagatami, the Japanese restaurant, has a seven-meter cypress sushi counter and serves sumibiyaki fired over ubame oak charcoal.
facts.excerpt: Dine at the restaurant's seven-meter cypress sushi counter. Taste sumibiyaki fired over high-grade ubame oak charcoal.

facts.text: Xiang Tao, the Chinese restaurant, features Cantonese cuisine and other regional Chinese dishes.
facts.excerpt: Xiang Tao features Cantonese cuisine and other regional Chinese delights

facts.text: Splendido is an all-day Italian restaurant on the first floor that serves breakfast.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy breakfast and simple yet delicious Italian cuisine prepared with the freshest ingredients at this all-day, Osaka restaurant on the 1st floor.

facts.text: The Riedel Room is a private dining room with gilt mirrors and hand-carved furnishings.
facts.excerpt: Book the spectacular Riedel Room, a private dining room with gilt mirrors and hand-carved furnishings.

facts.text: Spa treatments include the Shisui Detox Facial with matcha and the Ki Purifier & Rebalancer with sake.
facts.excerpt: such as the Shisui Detox Facial infused with matcha and the Ki Purifier & Rebalancer featuring sake

facts.text: The spa works with ESPA and La Prairie skincare products.
facts.excerpt: Skincare experts at ESPA and La Prairie provide products for results-driven facials.

facts.text: The hotel holds an art collection and offers an art tour exclusively for in-house guests.
facts.excerpt: We are pleased to offer an art tour, held exclusively for our in-house guests.

facts.text: The hotel offers staying guests complimentary activities such as running tours, origami lessons and bike rentals.
facts.excerpt: The Ritz-Carlton, Osaka offers complimentary, original activities for all staying guests.

facts.text: The Ritz Kids Night Safari for families provides a tent, mattress and lantern in the room.
facts.excerpt: Rooms are kitted out with a tent, mattress, and lantern

facts.text: Osaka Station is less than half a mile from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: less than half a mile from Osaka Station

facts.text: Umeda is a transport hub and business district.
facts.excerpt: Umeda, a transport hub and business district

facts.text: Guests with tattoos, including small fashion tattoos, are asked not to use the spa area.
facts.excerpt: Guests with tattoos, including small fashion tattoos, are kindly requested not to use the spa area.

facts.text: Club Lounge access requires an upgraded booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access.
facts.excerpt: Club access requires an upgraded booking at the Club. Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to Club.
